summary: PLDT Inc., a Philippine-listed telecom registrant filing as a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K with the SEC on October 8, 2026, disclosing a director's resignation — the equivalent US event being a board-departure Item 5.02 8-K. The filing consists solely of the disclosure letter submitted that same day to the Philippine Stock Exchange and Philippine SEC via SEC Form 17-C under Securities Regulation Code Section 17.1(b) and SRC Rule 17.1.1.1.3(b). No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing terms were stated. The identity of the resigning director and the reason were not disclosed in the excerpt. Watch for a successor appointment, possible committee/board-size changes, or any 20-F disclosure of governance or control implications.
